nl: Move the files in reports/ whose names start with [Q1] into the directory q1/ (create it).
oracle_program: find "reports" type: file |> filter name starts_with "[Q1]" |> move into: "q1"
reference_pwsh:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force q1 | Out-Null
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath reports -File | Where-Object { $_.Name.StartsWith('[Q1]') } | ForEach-Object { Move-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination q1 }

negatives.script:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force q1 | Out-Null
Move-Item reports/[Q1]* q1
negatives.defect: brackets act as a wildcard character class
